profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit AI safety and research company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company's website describes its AI, Claude, as built for problem solvers, with capabilities spanning complex reasoning, data analysis, and code writing.

Anthropic's primary product is Claude, a general-purpose large language model assistant available at claude.ai. For developers, the company offers the Anthropic Console, an API management platform that includes prompt testing, evaluation tools, usage monitoring, and cost controls. It also offers Claude Code, an agentic coding tool, and Computer Use, an agent capable of desktop automation and computer control, which the company notes involves high-privilege system access.

The held facts indicate Anthropic faces substantial litigation exposure, with twelve active cases tracked across multiple federal courts including the Northern District of California, the District of Delaware, the District of Hawaii, the District of Vermont, the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, and the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The cases include suits from individual plaintiffs as well as one brought by the University of Tennessee Research Foundation. California is flagged as the jurisdiction with the heaviest legal exposure, with 174 matters recorded under that classification.
